title: US Begins Military Evacuations From Qatar Base Amid Iran Tensions & Trump Threats Over Protests
text: US Begins Military Evacuations From Qatar Base Amid Iran Tensions & Trump Threats Over ProtestsThe United States has begun evacuating military personnel from bases in the Middle East amid rising tensions with Iran. Qatar confirmed military evacuations from the Al Udeid US Air Base, stating precautionary measures were taken due to regional instability. Multiple media reports suggest the US is withdrawing personnel following warnings from a senior Iranian official that Tehran would target American bases if Washington carries out strikes.
